chunks.title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
chunks.text:
PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Category: agriculture
Tags: farmer, agriculture, income, kisan, crop
Central government income support scheme for landholding farmer families. Provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank account.
Eligibility: All landholding farmer families subject to exclusion criteria (income tax payers in assessment year, constitutional post holders, etc.). Both small and marginal farmers are covered.
Documents required: Aadhaar card, Bank account details, Land ownership records
How to apply: Register through the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit the nearest agriculture department / Common Service Centre (CSC).

chunks.title: Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY
chunks.text:
Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY
Category: health
Tags: health, insurance, hospital, poor, bpl, senior
World's largest health insurance scheme providing coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization at empanelled public and private hospitals.
Eligibility: Families identified as deprived based on SECC 2011 data for rural areas and defined occupational categories for urban areas. State-specific expansion may cover additional families.
Documents required: Aadhaar card, Ration card or SECC eligibility letter, Mobile number
How to apply: Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in using mobile number or ration card. Visit an empanelled hospital or Ayushman Mitra for enrollment assistance.

chunks.title: Ration Card (PDS / NFSA)
chunks.text:
Ration Card (PDS / NFSA)
Category: food
Tags: ration, food, pds, bpl, apl, subsidy, groceries
State-issued card for subsidized food grains (rice, wheat, sugar) and other essentials through the Public Distribution System under the National Food Security Act.
Eligibility: Indian residents meeting state-specific income and family criteria. Categories include APL, BPL, and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) with different entitlements.
Documents required: Aadhaar cards of all family members, Passport-size photographs, Address proof, Income certificate (if applicable), Previous ration card (if any)
How to apply: Apply online through your state's food and civil supplies portal or visit the nearest ration office / CSC. Processing time varies by state.

chunks.title: Indian Passport Application
chunks.text:
Indian Passport Application
Category: documents
Tags: passport, travel, visa, document, identity
Official travel document issued by the Ministry of External Affairs through Passport Seva Kendras. Available as regular (36 pages) or jumbo (60 pages) booklet.
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen. Minors require parental consent and additional documents.
Documents required: Proof of address (Aadhaar, utility bill, bank passbook), Proof of date of birth (birth certificate, school leaving certificate, Aadhaar), Photo ID proof, Passport-size photographs
How to apply: Register on passportindia.gov.in, fill the application form, pay fees online, and book an appointment at the nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office PSK.

chunks.title: Aadhaar Enrollment and Update
chunks.text:
Aadhaar Enrollment and Update
Category: documents
Tags: aadhaar, uid, identity, biometric, document
12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI based on biometric and demographic data. Required for most government schemes and services.
Eligibility: Any resident of India (including infants). Non-residents are not eligible.
Documents required: Proof of identity (PAN, passport, voter ID, etc.), Proof of address, Proof of date of birth (for children under 5, only birth certificate needed)
How to apply: Visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Centre or book appointment on uidai.gov.in. Updates (address, mobile, photo) can be done online for supported fields.

chunks.title: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi NREGA)
chunks.text:
MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi NREGA)
Category: employment
Tags: employment, rural, labour, work, wages, job guarantee
Guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
Eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work. One Job Card per household.
Documents required: Aadhaar card, Passport-size photograph, Address proof in rural area
How to apply: Apply for a Job Card at the local Gram Panchayat office. Work is allocated through the Panchayat and wages are paid to bank/post office accounts.

chunks.title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
chunks.text:
Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Category: pension
Tags: pension, senior, retirement, unorganized, worker
Pension scheme for workers in the unorganized sector providing guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60, depending on contribution.
Eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18–40 years with a savings bank account. Must have Aadhaar and mobile number linked to the account.
Documents required: Aadhaar card, Bank account details, Mobile number
How to apply: Enroll through your bank branch or net banking. Auto-debit of contributions from the linked bank account.

chunks.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
chunks.text:
Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
Category: pension
Tags: pension, senior, elderly, old age, bpl
Central assistance of ₹200 per month (₹500 for persons above 80 years) plus state top-up for BPL persons aged 60 years and above.
Eligibility: Persons aged 60+ belonging to BPL households as per state BPL list. State governments may have additional criteria.
Documents required: Aadhaar card, Age proof (birth certificate, voter ID), BPL ration card or BPL certificate, Bank account details
How to apply: Apply through the Block Development Office, Gram Panchayat, or state social welfare department portal.

source.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)

chunks.title: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
chunks.text:
PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
Category: banking
Tags: bank, account, financial inclusion, zero balance, insurance
National mission for financial inclusion providing zero-balance bank accounts with RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover of ₹2 lakh, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000.
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen who does not have a bank account. One account per person.
Documents required: Aadhaar card (or other officially valid KYC document), Passport-size photograph
How to apply: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet with KYC documents. Account can be opened on the spot.

chunks.title: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan Scheme)
chunks.text:
PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan Scheme)
Category: business
Tags: street vendor, loan, business, micro credit, hawker
Special micro-credit facility providing collateral-free working capital loans up to ₹10,000 (first tranche), ₹20,000 (second), and ₹50,000 (third) to street vendors.
Eligibility: Street vendors in urban areas with Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body. Must have been vending before March 24, 2020.
Documents required: Aadhaar card, Vending certificate or ULB recommendation letter, Bank account details, Mobile number
How to apply: Apply through the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or through Urban Local Body / CSC.

chunks.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
chunks.text:
National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Category: education
Tags: scholarship, student, education, school, college
Single portal for applying to central and state government scholarships for school, college, and professional course students from SC, ST, OBC, minority, and economically weaker sections.
Eligibility: Varies by scholarship scheme — typically based on category, family income, academic performance, and institution type. Check specific scheme on scholarships.gov.in.
Documents required: Aadhaar / Bonafide certificate, Income certificate, Caste/category certificate (if applicable), Previous mark sheets, Bank account details, Institution verification form
How to apply: Register on scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal), select the relevant scheme, fill the application, and submit before the deadline.

chunks.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
chunks.text:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
Category: housing
Tags: housing, home, house, construction, urban, rural
Affordable housing scheme providing credit-linked subsidy on home loans for Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), and Middle Income Group (MIG) beneficiaries.
Eligibility: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house. Income limits vary: EWS up to ₹3 lakh, LIG ₹3–6 lakh, MIG-I ₹6–12 lakh, MIG-II ₹12–18 lakh per annum.
Documents required: Aadhaar cards of all family members, Income proof, Property documents (for existing house) or land documents (for construction), Bank loan sanction letter
How to apply: Apply through pmaymis.gov.in or via participating banks and housing finance companies for credit-linked subsidy.

chunks.title: PM Ujjwala Yojana
chunks.text:
PM Ujjwala Yojana
Category: welfare
Tags: lpg, gas, cylinder, cooking, women, bpl
Provides free LPG connections to women from BPL households to replace unclean cooking fuels. Includes deposit-free connection and first refill/flexible payment options.
Eligibility: Adult women from BPL households without an existing LPG connection. SECC 2011 list or BPL ration card holders are prioritized.
Documents required: BPL ration card or SECC list reference, Aadhaar card, Bank account details, Passport-size photograph
How to apply: Apply through your nearest LPG distributor or online via the PM Ujjwala portal. Distributor verifies eligibility and issues connection.

chunks.title: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
chunks.text:
PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Category: agriculture
Tags: farmer, crop insurance, agriculture, flood, drought
Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Low premium rates subsidized by government.
Eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas — both loanee and non-loanee farmers can enroll.
Documents required: Aadhaar card, Bank account details, Land records / sowing certificate, Crop details
How to apply: Enroll through banks (for loanee farmers), insurance companies, CSCs, or the PMFBY portal during the crop season enrollment window.

chunks.title: DigiLocker
chunks.text:
DigiLocker
Category: documents
Tags: documents, digital, certificate, license, storage
Government cloud platform for issuing and verifying documents and certificates digitally. Linked documents are legally equivalent to physical originals under IT Act.
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen with an Aadhaar number and mobile number.
Documents required: Aadhaar number, Mobile number (for OTP verification)
How to apply: Sign up at digilocker.gov.in using Aadhaar OTP. Pull documents issued by registered issuers (CBSE, RTO, income tax, etc.) into your locker.
